title: Narrative Capsules Chimeric Prototype
load_bearing_determinations: Strategy Canvas is the first exemplar target rather than a universal default.
Named module capsules are Narrative Capsule profile aliases, not new top-level classes.
Several capsule versions compose through CapsuleCompositionRecord.
AI Prompt Capsule is an enriched multi-source AIContextProjection.
Structured capsule versions remain source truth.
NOW, NEXT, and LATER map to current, good-enough, and desired through a named Strategy Canvas 2.0 adapter and migration receipt.
Context workshop state remains in the extensions.contextCanvas namespace.
Human ballots, system-derived aggregates, and AI-attributed proposals retain separate entity standing.
The optional AIShadowRound interaction follows human reveal, uses reviewed consent scope, remains local-only, and stays outside aggregate calculations.
Strategy Canvas 2.0 serializes that interaction as one extensions.contextCanvas.aiCollaboration record with attributed proposals.
Gaps, boundaries, receipt, and return remain explicit.
